title: La Carretera Austral, la ruta que abre las puertas al fin del mundo

narrative_signal.summary: The report frames the Carretera Austral as a gateway to the 'end of the world', expanding that international narrative beyond Tierra del Fuego and Cape Horn toward the wider Chilean Patagonia corridor.
narrative_signal.editorial_use: Treat as evidence of international positioning and narrative framing, not as the authority for infrastructure or operational facts.

claims.claim: The Carretera Austral is being internationally framed as a route that opens access to the Chilean 'end of the world'.
The 2026-2030 Plan Ruta Austral: Soberanía que conecta is an integrated state connectivity program centered on Ruta 7 in Aysén.
claims.authority: Ministerio de Obras Públicas de Chile

claims.claim: The plan considers investment close to CLP 800 billion and intervention of 244 km, including road, maritime and lacustrine connectivity projects.
claims.authority: Ministerio de Obras Públicas de Chile

claims.claim: The state program explicitly links Carretera Austral investment with connectivity, territorial integration, sovereignty, regional development and tourism.
claims.authority: Ministerio de Obras Públicas de Chile
